# Buzz Lab API
Vibration recordings from a phone in a car. All paths except /healthz need HTTP basic auth. Replies are JSON; errors are {"error": "..."}.

GET /api/cars                      cars and how many drives each has
GET /api/drives                    drives, newest first, with a short summary
GET /api/drives/{id}               one drive: spectrum, per-speed rows, the passenger's marks
GET /api/average?car=Hatchback           every matching drive of one car combined, weighted by seconds of steady driving
GET /api/drives/{id}/raw.zip       raw readings in phyphox CSV layout, when they were uploaded
GET /api/drives/{id}/track          positions once a second with t in seconds from the first reading, empty when sent without them
POST /api/upload                   body is an app export zip. Sending a drive again replaces it
GET /api/export.zip                everything: the SQLite database and all raw uploads
DELETE /api/drives/{id}            removes a drive and its raw readings

Filters for drives and average: car (id or name), place, from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive), min_mph and max_mph (0 to 80, steps of 5, default 10 to 80).

Units: band_rms_ms2 is m/s2 rms summed over three axes. amplitude_by_hz is m/s2 per sqrt(Hz). Upper band edges are exclusive.
phone_length_share_25_35hz is the share along the phone's long side, which is fore-aft when the phone lies flat with its top pointing forward.
Steady driving means 2-second windows where speed varied by under 2 mph (standard deviation).

Reading it: a fixed frequency at every speed suggests a resonance. Something turning with the wheels rises in step with speed.
Compare drives only on the same road, phone position and speed. A loose phone can add its own resonance. These numbers do not show a cause.
Positions include home. Do not put them in anything shared with others unless the owner asks.
